input.summary: Add a TrueLink performance/conformance warranty with a repair, replace, re-perform or refund remedy.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives us only a Y2K warranty, so TrueLink stands behind neither the Interface nor the Hosting and Support Services. We have added our standard performance warranty (professional and workmanlike services, conformance to documentation, no malicious code, compliance with laws) with a repair/re-performance/refund remedy; we can accept ninety (90) days for the Interface and thirty (30) days for the Services if the longer periods are an issue.

ops.text: TrueLink further represents and warrants that: (a) the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards; (b) for a period of twelve (12) months following delivery, the Interface and all related software will conform in all material respects to its documentation and specifications; (c) the Interface and all related software will be free of viruses, worms, Trojan horses and other malicious code; and (d) TrueLink will comply in all material respects with all laws applicable to its performance under this Agreement. Client's sole remedy for breach of the foregoing warranties is, at TrueLink's option, re-performance, repair or replacement, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Interface, software or services.
